ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and purple-red leaves with ruffled edges, lightly dressed and glossy, covering roughly 55% of the plate's footprint in a loose mound about 5 cm high | 110
ITEM 2 | Halved cherry tomatoes, bright red with pale seed centers, cut face up, about 6 pieces each 2 cm across, scattered on the upper left and lower left of the greens | 45
ITEM 3 | Dark olives, glossy dark purple-black, whole or halved, about 1.5 cm across, scattered among the greens, about 6 pieces | 20
ITEM 4 | Thin red onion slivers, pinkish-purple translucent rings and strips about 4 cm long, scattered over the greens | 10
ITEM 5 | Crumbled white cheese, pale off-white pieces about 0.5 cm, small scattered crumbles on top of the greens and near the olives | 8
ITEM 6 | Light vinaigrette dressing, thin sheen and small pooled droplets on the greens and plate surface, no distinct pooling volume | 5
